text: Program Description 1. Period of Study After formal admission, students will have a full-time study for 4 years in China University of Political Science and Law (CUPL). 2. Specialized required courses Public Administration Theory Science Of Management Psychology Civil Service System Administrative Law And Procedure Theory Of Administrative Organization Foreign Public Administration Policy Science Human Resources Management In Public Sector Contemporary Chinese Government And Public Administration Management required courses Management Science An Introduction To Political Science An Introduction To Public Management An Introduction To Sociology An Introduction To Public Affairs Governmental Economics Public required courses Fundamentals of Computer Applications An Introduction to Chinese Civilization An Introduction to Western Civilization Chinese-1 Chinses-2 General Introduction to China 3. Tuition and Application Fee of the Preparatory Courses Tuition is 20,000 RMB per year; application fee is 660 RMB. Those whose Chinese proficiency is under HSK level 5, without receiving preparatory courses and intend to directly enter bachelor's degree study need to pay the application service fee 10,000 RMB (including the related costs used for: Chinese courses, major courses, guidance to studying abroad, selection of majors and completion of relevant procedures etc.). 4. Accommodations Students can live in the students’ apartments arranged by the School of International Education, or solve accommodations by themselves. 5. Scholarship Foreign students will obtain "the scholarship for freshmen", once they are admitted by our university as freshmen.
